phases.title: Shared infrastructure setup for JWT authentication

tasks.title: Register database context and User entity
tasks.outcome: User entity is mapped in the database context; schema includes users table with id, email, passwordHash columns

commit.subject: add User entity and database context registration

tasks.title: Create RefreshToken entity and migration
tasks.outcome: RefreshToken entity is mapped; migration creates refresh_tokens table with token, userId, expiresAt columns

tasks.title: Configure JWT signing secret and token expiry constants
tasks.outcome: JWT_SECRET, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRY (15m), and REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY (7d) constants are loaded from environment variables and exported

commit.subject: add JWT signing secret and expiry config constants

tasks.title: Implement JwtService — sign and verify helpers
tasks.outcome: JwtService class exists with signAccessToken(userId) and verifyToken(token) methods; uses INFRA-TASK-BE-01 constants

commit.subject: add JwtService sign and verify helpers

tasks.title: Implement PasswordService — hash and compare helpers
tasks.outcome: PasswordService class exists with hashPassword(plain) and comparePassword(plain, hash) methods using bcrypt

phases.title: As an anonymous user, I want to register with email and password, so that I can access the system

tasks.title: Implement RegisterUserService
tasks.outcome: RegisterUserService class exists with register(email, password) method; validates uniqueness, hashes password via PasswordService, persists User, returns user id and email

commit.subject: add RegisterUserService with uniqueness and hash validation

tasks.title: Implement POST /auth/register endpoint
tasks.outcome: POST /auth/register controller action exists; validates request body (email, password), delegates to RegisterUserService, returns 201 on success or 409 on duplicate email

tasks.title: Tests: user registration — success, duplicate email, password hashing
tasks.outcome: Jest test suite for RegisterUserService and POST /auth/register covering 201 success, 409 conflict, and bcrypt hash verification

commit.subject: add registration unit and integration tests

phases.title: As a registered user, I want to log in with my credentials, so that I receive JWT access and refresh tokens

tasks.title: Implement LoginService
tasks.outcome: LoginService class exists with login(email, password) method; validates credentials via PasswordService, signs access and refresh tokens via JwtService, persists RefreshToken, returns both tokens

commit.subject: add LoginService with credential validation and token issuance

tasks.title: Implement POST /auth/login endpoint
tasks.outcome: POST /auth/login controller action exists; validates request body, delegates to LoginService, returns 200 with accessToken and refreshToken or 401 on invalid credentials

tasks.title: Tests: user login — success, invalid password, unknown email
tasks.outcome: Jest test suite for LoginService and POST /auth/login covering 200 with tokens, 401 on bad password, and 401 on unknown email

commit.subject: add login unit and integration tests

phases.title: As an authenticated client, I want to refresh my access token, so that I stay logged in without re-entering credentials

tasks.title: Implement TokenRefreshService
tasks.outcome: TokenRefreshService class exists with refresh(refreshToken) method; validates token via JwtService, invalidates old RefreshToken, issues new access and refresh tokens, persists new RefreshToken

tasks.title: Implement POST /auth/refresh endpoint
tasks.outcome: POST /auth/refresh controller action exists; validates request body, delegates to TokenRefreshService, returns 200 with new accessToken and refreshToken or 401 on invalid/expired token

tasks.title: Tests: token refresh — success with rotation, expired token, reuse of invalidated token
tasks.outcome: Jest test suite for TokenRefreshService and POST /auth/refresh covering 200 with rotated tokens, 401 on expired token, and 401 on reuse of already-invalidated token

commit.subject: add token refresh unit and integration tests
